lugaro_cell_cerebellum.label: Lugaro cell
lugaro_cell_cerebellum.note: Name match is exact. CL:0011006 definition describes a cerebellar interneuron with spindle-shaped/triangular soma at the granule layer / Purkinje cell layer border, parasagittally oriented dendrites, axonal plexus projecting into the molecular layer with long transverse collaterals, and GABAergic/glycinergic co-release (GAD65/67 + GlyT2) — all consistent with the proposed type. A mouse-specific taxon-restricted subtype also exists (CL:4301575, 'Lugaro cell (Mmus)'), distinguished by Pthlh/Tfap2b/Rspo2 expression and corresponding to Yao et al. 2023 supertype CB PLI Gly-Gaba_2; this may be relevant for atlas-side stub linking. Definition references (xrefs) were not returned by the OLS4 fetch endpoint and should be retrieved directly from http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/CL_0011006 or the CL source OWL if needed.
